title: Israel's far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir celebrates the detention of a Palestinian bride and groom in the Negev in a social media post, saying they were detained after their wedding convoy caused intentional traffic jams and disrupted traffic
text:
Israel's far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir celebrates the detention of a Palestinian bride and groom in the Negev in a social media post, saying they were detained after their wedding convoy caused intentional traffic jams and disrupted traffic"

"'Whoever thinks they can drive however they want on the Negev roads—let them keep thinking that!', Ben-Gvir says in the post
